zh.title: 美國聯邦航空總署認證雪納多大學加入管制員快速培訓計畫
zh.summary: 聯邦航空總署認證雪納多大學為第13所E-CTI學校；畢業生可跳過俄克拉荷馬城學院直接進入設施訓練
body: 美國運輸部長肖恩·杜菲宣布，聯邦航空總署（FAA）已與維吉尼亞州的雪納多大學建立合作夥伴關係，使其加入強化空中交通管制大學培訓計畫（E-CTI）。這項計畫讓通過考核的學生可申請成為管制員，並享有快速通道——可略過位於俄克拉荷馬城的聯邦航空總署學院，直接進入實地設施接受訓練。
根據聯邦航空總署的聲明，雪納多大學是第13所獲得E-CTI認證的學校，也是杜菲部長領導下第10所獲認證的院校。聯邦航空總署署長布萊恩·貝德福德表示，這項合作標誌著加強和現代化管制員培訓管道的另一關鍵步驟，國家空域系統的安全仍是首要任務。
杜菲部長指出，在川普政府執政前18個月，聯邦航空總署的管制員培訓管道已達到創紀錄的4,000人，人員編制水平創十年新高。該部門還採取了大膽行動，創造新的財務激勵措施並留任現有管制員。
完成E-CTI計畫並通過最終表現與筆試評核的學生，將獲得聯邦航空總署官方背書證書。這些畢業生隨後可申請成為管制員，並在通過空中交通技能評估測試、符合醫療與安全要求後，直接被安置在聯邦航空總署設施開始訓練。
此協議專門針對雪納多大學的塔台管制課程，成功學生將有機會被安置在聯邦航空總署的空中交通管制塔台。這與標準AT-CTI計畫不同，後者的畢業生仍需前往聯邦航空總署學院，但可免修入門級的空中交通基礎課程。
聯邦航空總署同時也提供全年招募機會給來自軍方和私營產業的資深管制員，並持續擴大使用現代化模擬器，讓受訓者沉浸在真實場景中以強化訓練成效。

en.title: FAA Certifies Shenandoah University for Enhanced Air Traffic Controller Training Program
en.summary: FAA certifies Shenandoah University as 13th E-CTI school; graduates bypass Oklahoma City academy for direct facility training
body: U.S. Transportation Secretary Sean P. Duffy announced that the Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) has partnered with Shenandoah University in Virginia to join the Enhanced Air Traffic – Collegiate Training Initiative (E-CTI). Students who pass the E-CTI program can apply to become controllers on a fast track – skipping the FAA Academy in Oklahoma City and jumping straight to on-site facility training.

According to the FAA, Shenandoah University is the 13th school to be certified as an E-CTI program and the 10th under Secretary Duffy. FAA Administrator Bryan Bedford said the partnership marks another vital step in the ongoing commitment to strengthen and modernize the air traffic controller pipeline, with the safety of the National Airspace System remaining the top priority.

Secretary Duffy noted that in the first 18 months of the Trump Administration, the FAA has a record-breaking 4,000 controllers in the training pipeline and reached the highest staffing levels in a decade. The agency has taken bold action to supercharge the controller hiring pipeline, create new financial incentives, and retain existing controllers.

E-CTI students who pass final performance and written assessments receive an official FAA endorsement certificate. These graduates can then apply to become a controller and be placed directly in an FAA facility to begin training, provided they pass the Air Traffic Skills Assessment test and meet medical and security requirements.

The agreement with Shenandoah University is for its control tower program, allowing successful students the opportunity to be placed in an FAA air traffic control tower. This differs from the Standard AT-CTI, where graduates still go to the FAA Academy but bypass the introductory Air Traffic Basics Course, having already completed it at their Standard AT-CTI school.

The FAA also offers a year-round hiring opportunity for experienced controllers from the military and private industry and continues to expand its use of modernized simulators that enhance training by immersing trainees in real-world scenarios.
